===================================================
               CHANGELOG
===================================================

[v1.4.2] - 2024-01-15
  FIXED   Payment webhook signature validation for Stripe v3
  FIXED   Race condition in order status update under high concurrency
  FIXED   Memory leak in WebSocket connection pool
  FIXED   Incorrect tax calculation for EU customers with VAT exemption

[v1.4.1] - 2024-01-08
  FIXED   Login redirect loop on Safari 17
  FIXED   Product image upload failing for files > 5MB
  FIXED   Cache invalidation not triggered on price update
  CHANGED Increased session timeout from 30min to 60min
  CHANGED Upgraded spring-boot from 3.2.0 to 3.2.1

[v1.4.0] - 2023-12-20
  ADDED   Dark mode support across all pages
  ADDED   Multi-currency checkout (USD, EUR, JPY, VND)
  ADDED   Product review and rating system
  ADDED   Real-time order tracking via WebSocket
  ADDED   Admin dashboard with sales analytics
  CHANGED Redesigned checkout flow (3-step to 1-page)
  CHANGED Migrated from REST to GraphQL for product queries
  CHANGED Search engine replaced with Elasticsearch
  FIXED   Pagination bug returning duplicate items on page boundary
  FIXED   Email notifications sent twice on order confirmation

[v1.3.5] - 2023-11-30
  FIXED   XSS vulnerability in product description field
  FIXED   SQL injection risk in search query builder
  FIXED   CSRF token not validated on password change endpoint
  SECURITY Rotated all internal API keys
  SECURITY Enforced TLS 1.2+ across all services

[v1.3.4] - 2023-11-22
  FIXED   Order export to CSV missing last row
  FIXED   Stock count goes negative under concurrent purchases
  FIXED   Promo code applied twice when user clicks fast
  CHANGED Promo code now locked for 5s after first application

[v1.3.3] - 2023-11-10
  ADDED   Bulk product import via CSV
  ADDED   Webhook support for order events
  ADDED   Rate limiting on public API (100 req/min)
  FIXED   Forgot password email not sent when username contains +
  FIXED   Dashboard chart renders blank on Firefox 119

[v1.3.2] - 2023-10-28
  FIXED   404 on product URL after category rename
  FIXED   Image gallery not loading on slow connections
  CHANGED Default sort order changed from "newest" to "relevance"

[v1.3.0] - 2023-10-01
  ADDED   Affiliate/referral program
  ADDED   Gift card purchase and redemption
  ADDED   Inventory low-stock alerts via email
  ADDED   Product bundle / combo pricing
  CHANGED Checkout requires phone number for SMS updates
  DEPRECATED  Legacy v1 REST endpoints (removal in v2.0.0)

===================================================
END OF CHANGELOG
===================================================
